notes.title: 78.070925 release.
notes.content:
• Updated Unity to Unity 6.2 (6000.2.2f1) — this should fix the previous issue with the player crashing to desktop after the splash screen but if there are issues (specifically on Windows, or Windows on ARM) please get in touch.
• Added an option under the Graphics settings to disable the in-game cursor in favour of the OS system cursor if preferred.
• When TTS is enabled, the text being spoken will be automatically sent to the clipboard on desktop platforms.
• Fixed a bug with the Status Tray's Maladies icons that were generating placeholder TTS strings by mistake.
• Rebuilt the Save/Load menu to add an overwrite option over existing saves.
• Saving a game now automatically closes the Save/Load menu.

notes.title: 77.250625 release
notes.content:
[b]June 25 2025 —[/b]
• 77.250625 release.
• Reverted Unity version back to the LTS 6 branch (6000.0.51f1) due to issues with the player failing to run on many Windows systems. Please report any crash-to-desktop issues at launch if you're still encountering them!

notes.title: 75.240425 release.
notes.content:
• Updated Unity version to 6000.0.47f1.
• Fixed an issue where moving the keyboard/controller "picker" over a Choice requirement would not visibly show the mouseover tooltip associated with those requirements.
• Fixed an issue in Insubstantial Actuality that could prevent progress through an edge case of specific past choices.

notes.title: 74.110425 release.
notes.content:
• Fixed an issue where the last-seen conversation associated with a Hub was not being saved; this could create an edge case where a player could be mid-Encounter, swap Hubs, save and reload, and then be unable to progress the game further.
• Fixed an issue where in some cases bubbles that had an animation applied to them could get stuck in the wrong position.
• Fixed some audio bugs in a couple of places.
• Changed the order of Hub unlocks to avoid cases where players access new storylines before completing their current one.
• Slight writing tweaks in a couple of spots.
• Added some robustness to the evaluation of the tutorial Hubs to avoid unintended behaviour in Chapter One.

notes.content:

notes.title: 72.090425 release.
notes.content:
• Updated Unity version to 6000.0.45f1.
• Added an initial "Profile" tab to the inventory which showcases your choices in character creation once players have completed that step — thanks to DeltaHyperian for the suggestion.
• Added a TTS speech rate slider to the audio settings — default is 100%, this can be slowed to 50% or increased to 150%.
• Fixed save games not being read out via the TTS system.
• Improvements to the TTS behaviour, line breaks should properly cause it to pause instead of barrelling through to the next line.
• TTS for equipped items in the inventory will now read out the item's name and stats.
• TTS in the Status Tray now tells you whether or not you have an item equipped, and which item if so.
• Removed an erroneous test sound left in the inventory screen if you try to unequip an item when you have nothing equipped.
• Fixed a couple of reported typos and misbehaving glossary entries.
• Fixed an issue where resting at the Citadel in Chapter Five could prevent further progression.
• Changed the text size labels in Options to read "Normal, Large, Extra Large" instead of obsolete numerical values.
• As a backend development tool I've now got an option to import external saves from other players (for many reasons the Steam versions are going to be easiest to do this with) to help debug progression issues.

notes.title: 70.040425 release.
notes.content:
• 70.040425 release.
• Fixed a couple of storylines not properly being internally associated with their respective Hubs (didn't affect progression but might have made it impossible to get back to them if you started a different storyline at the same time).

• Fixed a Cinemachine glitch in the last update that caused the camera to misbehave.
